fact: Djibouti Telecom's D-Money officially launched its new smartphone application on 26 September 2024, open to all Djiboutians since 21 September, for money transfers, bill payment and online purchases of services.

The Ministry of Communication says Djibouti Telecom's D-Money, a recently launched mobile money service for transfers, payments, bill payment and airtime through agents and an app, already has thousands of subscribers, including three ministers who opened wallets.

UNCDF's Djibouti diagnostic (February 2023) states that state-owned Djibouti Telecom launched D-Money, a digital mobile money service for transfers and payments from mobile phones, across the country on 22 June 2020.
D-Money (Djibouti Telecom) promotes its mobile wallet app as in service in a post of 29 July 2025, with customers sending money from the wallet.
